title: clean-my-cache recipe
description: Teaches clean-my-cache how to clean one app or tool.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Used in --only and explain. Never rename it after release.

risk.description: safe: rebuilt automatically. redownload: nothing lost but slow to get back. caution: never selected by default.

description.description: What it is and what happens after cleaning, in plain words.

app.description: Name of the .app in /Applications, without .app. The recipe is skipped while the app is open.

preset.description: electron: adds Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache, DawnGraphiteCache and DawnWebGPUCache inside ~/Library/Application Support/<support_folder>.

support_folder.description: Folder inside ~/Library/Application Support used by the preset. * matches one folder level.

paths.description: Folders to delete. Start with ~/. * matches one folder level.

paths_from.description: Folders found by running a command.

run.description: The tool's own clean command, as a program and its arguments. Never a shell.

measure.description: Folders used to show the size before and after the command.

precheck.description: Command that must succeed before run, like [docker, info].

command.description: Command that prints one folder path.

siblings.description: Use the folders next to the printed one that match this pattern, excluding the printed folder itself.
